_notes.taxonomy_source: Categories mirror the Pitts Ads dataset (Hussain et al., CVPR 2017) and the AdsQA benchmark (arXiv 2509.08621). We use four categories — kept deliberately small so the experiment has at least 3 ads per category and the factor 'ad category' is analytically tractable (e.g., as a within-subjects factor, or to control category effects in a personalisation × placement design).
_notes.url_status: All `video_url` values are either verified public-domain clips on the Internet Archive (clips marked source=archive_org) or synthesised by the generator script at scripts/generate_ads.py (source=synthetic).
_notes.how_to_use_in_ads_slots: Each entry in experiment.json's `ads` array can either inline the legacy fields (url, placement, etc.) or set `library_ref` to one of the ids below; the player resolves library_ref before scheduling. See app.py::resolve_ad().
